about: SP2: a customer turn must never end with nothing sent and the chat handed to a person. Found by M1 (5 live cases over language-pack runs 43642090610, 43644483826, 43649220096, 43657020370) and once on staging (14 Nov 08:13 Beirut, an address-only message: agent_runs concierge outcome handoff, handoffs reason agent_did_not_finish). Two causes in packages/agents/src/concierge.ts: a model call stops at max_tokens before any tool, or the model calls extract_order and ends the turn. `scripted`: the model's steps as recorded (stop reason, tools, free text), replayed through runAskLoop by evals/test/no-reply.test.ts; `expect` is the tool that must reach the customer, or `handoff` for a model that never answers (fail closed). `live`: the same situations as customer messages, run on the real model by evals/live (zero turns may end with nothing sent). Every name and address here is invented.
